blocks.task_summary: Find the least integer n for X ~ B(n, 0.25) such that P(X ≥ 1) > 0.99, using complement rule P(X ≥ 1) = 1 − (0.75)^n and solving the exponential inequality.
accepted_alternatives: GDC binomial CDF table: compute P(X ≥ 1) for n = 16 (≈0.98998 < 0.99) and n = 17 (≈0.99248 > 0.99), conclude n = 17

evidence.basis: METHOD 1: correct inequality or equation involving P(X = 0) (A1); attempts to solve inequality involving 0.75^n for n (M1); 1 − 0.75^n > 0.99 OR 0.75^n < 0.01; n > 16.0078... (A2); least value n = 17 A1

METHOD 2: attempts binomial cdf for one value of n (M1); correct P(X ≥ 1) values (A1); P(X ≥ 1) = 0.989977... < 0.99 for n = 16 (A1); P(X ≥ 1) = 0.992483... > 0.99 for n = 17 (A1); least value n = 17 A1

blocks.task_summary: Given a spherical bubble with volume increasing at a constant rate of 5 cm³ s⁻¹ and initial volume zero, find the rate at which the radius increases when the volume is 20 cm³.
method_path: Solve V = (4/3)πr³ for r when V = 20 to obtain r = (15/π)^(1/3)
Differentiate V with respect to r: dV/dr = 4πr²
Apply the chain rule: dV/dt = dV/dr × dr/dt (or equivalently dr/dt = dr/dV × dV/dt)
Substitute dV/dt = 5 and the computed r value to find dr/dt = 5/(4π(15/π)^(2/3)) ≈ 0.140 cm s⁻¹

evidence.basis: attempts to solve (4/3)πr³ = 20 for r (M1); r = (15/π)^(1/3) ≈ 1.68389... A1; attempts to use the chain rule dV/dt = dV/dr × dr/dt OR dr/dt = dr/dV × dV/dt (M1); A1 for correct derivative expression; attempts to find dr/dt when dV/dt = 5 (M1); dr/dt = (5/(4π))(π/15)^(2/3) ≈ 0.140 cm s⁻¹ A1

blocks.task_summary: Find the volume of the solid formed when the curve y = 4 ln(x - 2) for 0 ≤ y ≤ 4 is rotated 360° about the y-axis.
method_path: Express x in terms of y: x = 2 + e^(y/4)
Square to obtain x² = (2 + e^(y/4))² = 4 + 4e^(y/4) + e^(y/2)
Set up volume integral V = π ∫₀⁴ x² dy

evidence.basis: attempts to express x (or x²) in terms of y (M1); x² = (2 + e^(y/4))² = 4 + 4e^(y/4) + e^(y/2) (A1); forms a definite integral of the form π∫x² dy (M1); V = π∫₀⁴ (e^(y/2) + 4e^(y/4) + 4) dy (A1); 176.779... = 177 = 2π(e² + 8e − 1) (A1)

blocks.task_summary: Show that arg z = θ for z = 1 + cos 2θ + i sin 2θ, given −π/2 < θ < π/2.
method_path: Apply double-angle identities: sin 2θ = 2 sin θ cos θ, 1 + cos 2θ = 2 cos²θ
Conclude arg z = θ for −π/2 < θ < π/2
accepted_alternatives: METHOD 2: Rewrite z = 1 + (2cos²θ − 1) + i(2 sin θ cos θ) = 2 cos θ (cos θ + i sin θ) = 2 cos θ cis θ, hence arg z = θ and |z| = 2 cos θ.

evidence.basis: A1 for arctan(sin2θ/(1+cos2θ)); M1 for uses 2sinθcosθ in numerator and any double angle identity for cos2θ in denominator; A1 for arg z = arctan(tan θ) → arg z = θ.

blocks.task_summary: Show that |z| = 2 cos θ for z = 1 + cos 2θ + i sin 2θ, given −π/2 < θ < π/2.
method_path: Expand (1 + cos 2θ)² and apply cos² 2θ + sin² 2θ = 1
Use cos 2θ = 2 cos²θ − 1 to get |z| = √(4 cos²θ) = 2 cos θ
accepted_alternatives: METHOD 2: z = 2 cos²θ + i(2 sin θ cos θ) = 2 cos θ (cos θ + i sin θ), so |z| = 2 cos θ.

evidence.basis: M1 for attempt to express |z| = √(Re² + Im²); M1 for expanding (1+cos2θ)² then using cos²2θ+sin²2θ=1; A1 for √(2+2cos2θ); A1 for 2cosθ.

blocks.task_summary: Find constants a, b, c in the rational function using three conditions: vertical asymptote x=1 gives a+b+c=0; point (2,1) gives 4a+2b+c=-2; local minimum at x=2 gives dy/dx=0 yielding 12a+4b+c=0. Solve the linear system to obtain a=3, b=-11, c=8.
method_path: Set denominator to zero at vertical asymptote x=1 to obtain a+b+c=0
Substitute point (2,1) into curve equation to obtain 4a+2b+c=-2
Differentiate using quotient rule to find dy/dx
Set numerator of derivative to zero at x=2 to obtain 12a+4b+c=0
Solve the system of three linear equations to find a=3, b=-11, c=8

evidence.basis: recognizes that x=1 implies ax^2+bx+c=0 (M1); a+b+c=0 (seen anywhere) A1
passes through (2,1) so: (4-2)/(4a+2b+c)=1 implies 2=4a+2b+c (seen anywhere) A1
attempts to find dy/dx using quotient or product rule M1; substitutes x=2 into numerator of dy/dx=0 (M1); (12a+4b+c)=0 A1
attempts to solve their 3 linear equations (M1); a=3, b=-11 and c=8 A1
